gloss: monetary gift envelope; gift envelope for money

definitions.gloss: monetary gift envelope; gift envelope for money
definitions.explanation: A decorative envelope used to present monetary gifts on ceremonial occasions such as weddings, funerals, and celebrations.

examples.japanese: {金封|きんぷう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧{金封|きんぷう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a gift envelope to bring to the wedding.

examples.japanese: {金封|きんぷう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水引|みずひき}→水引：29258_mizuhiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{祝|いわ}い{事|ごと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{弔|とむら}い{事|ごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Gift envelopes are distinguished between celebrations and condolences by the type of decorative cord.

notes:
A compound of {金|きん} (money) and {封|ぷう} (seal, envelope). The formal term for the decorated envelopes used to present money at Japanese ceremonies. The envelope design, including the ⟦{水引|みずひき}→水引：29258_mizuhiki⟧ (decorative cord) and ⟦{熨斗|のし}→熨斗：07133_noshi⟧ (decorative paper), varies depending on the occasion.

For celebrations ({慶事|けいじ}), red and white or gold and silver cords are used. For condolences ({弔事|ちょうじ}), black and white or silver cords are used. Using the wrong type is considered a serious social error.
